changeSet.sql:
insert into sections (nom, type) select coalesce(nullif(trim(a.groupe_filtre), ''), a.groupe), case when max(case when a.groupe = 'COMPETITION' then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 'COMPETITION' else 'NON_COMPETITIVE' end from activites a where coalesce(nullif(trim(a.groupe_filtre), ''), a.groupe) is not null and not exists (select 1 from sections s where s.nom = coalesce(nullif(trim(a.groupe_filtre), ''), a.groupe)) group by coalesce(nullif(trim(a.groupe_filtre), ''), a.groupe);
update activites set section_id = (select s.id from sections s where s.nom = coalesce(nullif(trim(activites.groupe_filtre), ''), activites.groupe));
